headers.title: Headers and constants
headers.text: The site as Referer on every picture; COVER_ATTR the image attribute of the covers.

getPopular.title: Popular (directory)
getPopular.text: FoolSlide has no popularity order, so Popular is the alphabetical /directory/N/: .group blocks with .title a and a cover.

getLatest.title: Latest
getLatest.text: /latest/N/, one .group per series with its newest chapters.

search.title: Search
search.text: POST /search/ with search=words; FoolSlide gives one page of results.

getDetails.title: Title page
getDetails.text: h1.title, the .thumbnail image and the Author / Synopsis lines of the .info text.

getChapterList.title: Chapters
getChapterList.text: .list .element rows: .title a as link and name, .meta_r for the group and date; the number comes from the /read/ address (volume/chapter/sub).

getPageList.title: Pages
getPageList.text: The reader's `var pages = [...]` script; older readers print tags in #page.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.text: One request with the site as Referer, the shared .group parser (each series once), absolute addresses, the cover attribute chain and the first number of a text.
